items.title: SP-API Release Notes
items.excerpt: Selling Partner API new features, software updates, and changelog.
items.body: For releases prior to January 19, 2022, refer to Announcements in the Selling Partner API GitHub repo . May 27, 2026 API changes Listings Restrictions API v2021-08-01 Added the optional productType query parameter to the getListingsRestrictions operation. You can use this parameter along with a brand name to evaluate GTIN exemption restrictions for a specific product type. Notifications API v1 Added the filterExpression field to the createSubscription operation. You can use this field to filter events before notification delivery. Filters are applied to the notification payload using Common Expression Language (CEL) syntax. Added DeliveryTipChange as a supported order change type to the OrderChangeType notification schema. You can use this to track the status of a delivery tip for an order. Orders API v0 The following updates apply to veterinary products: Added the approvedAlternativeDetails field to the VerificationDetails object in the updateVerificationStatus operation. You can use this field to submit pre-approved alternative product attributes. Added the interimStatusDetail field to the VerificationDetails object in the updateVerificationStatus operation. You can use this field to provide granular progress updates while an order is pending verification to indicate that a veterinarian has been contacted. Added the ValidInterimStatusCodes field to the RegulatedOrderVerificationStatus object in the getOrderRegulatedInfo response. This field returns the list of supported interim status codes and customer-facing descriptions that you can use when you provide an interimStatusDetail .
